challenges.text: Even a 20% prevention effect is unverified. Test a small opt-in pilot and compare recurrence without delaying essential repairs.

decisions.action: Scope a voluntary retrofit pilot before committing the district.
decisions.rationale: Sharing clears the modeled backlog sooner. A bounded prevention pilot could reduce future recurring work, but its added materials and early delays need evidence.
decisions.authority: No authority is established. A resident-led process must agree on the pilot before any work begins.
decisions.consent: Resident opt-in, paid or voluntary labor agreements, and permission to use materials.
decisions.success: Measure recurring needs and repair waiting time by neighborhood. Seek resident feedback, including anyone who declines participation.
decisions.reversal: Stop if essential repairs are delayed, consent is withdrawn, or material use exceeds the agreed pilot limit.
